title: Autostart apps and scripts launch before auto-mounted disks are mounted, which can break them
line: Disks set to mount on login are now mounted before Plasma and autostarted apps start, so wallpapers and files on them are there at login.
explanation: The removable-device automounter is a kded module that starts login mounts asynchronously, while plasmashell and xdg-desktop-autostart.target start in parallel with kded. Nothing waited for those mounts, so anything that read a path on such a disk at startup (wallpaper, KTorrent, Flatpak installs, session Locations) found it missing and fell back or failed. The automounter now has a waitForLoginMounts D-Bus call that returns once its login mounts have finished (or right away when automounting is off), and a oneshot unit plasma-device-automounter-wait.service, pulled in by plasma-core.target and ordered before plasmashell and autostart, makes that call with a 10 s timeout.

commits.message:
solid-device-automounter: let the session wait for login automounts

Disks set to mount on login were mounted alongside plasmashell and
autostarted apps, so files on them were missing at startup. Add a D-Bus
call that returns once those mounts finish, and a unit to order on it.

BUG: 323151

startkde: wait for login automounts before starting the shell

Plasmashell and autostart ran before disks set to mount on login were
mounted, so wallpapers and other files on them were missing at startup.
Pull in the automounter's wait unit, which gives up after ten seconds.

BUG: 323151

patches.diff:
From 0920466265c0daa8eb4c3cbad3eb0c9b75eb17c8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 18:29:23 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] startkde: wait for login automounts before starting the shell

Plasmashell and autostart ran before disks set to mount on login were
mounted, so wallpapers and other files on them were missing at startup.
Pull in the automounter's wait unit, which gives up after ten seconds.

BUG: 323151
---
 startkde/systemd/plasma-core.target | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/startkde/systemd/plasma-core.target b/startkde/systemd/plasma-core.target
index 0077bc2674..78bdfed8ae 100644
--- a/startkde/systemd/plasma-core.target
+++ b/startkde/systemd/plasma-core.target
@@ -2,6 +2,7 @@
 Description=KDE Plasma Workspace Core
 Wants=plasma-plasmashell.service
 Wants=plasma-kded6.service
+Wants=plasma-device-automounter-wait.service
 Wants=graphical-session-pre.target
 Wants=plasma-ksmserver.service
 After=graphical-session-pre.target
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: wallpaper set to an image on a USB disk that is automounted on login (mount takes 4 s). Plasmashell starts before the mount and shows the default wallpaper, still 20 s later
With the fix, same disk and wallpaper: plasmashell starts once the disk is mounted (4.6 s after kded) and shows the wallpaper from the disk
